problem: The live pricing browser verifier could not observe ready-v3 and the page renderer became unresponsive after DOMContentLoaded.
root_cause: pricing-interactions-rescue-v1 observed all body childList mutations while syncFromDom itself rewrote price and period textContent. Those self-generated childList mutations re-triggered syncFromDom through queueMicrotask, creating a self-sustaining microtask loop that starved browser automation and interaction readiness.
prevention: MutationObserver recovery may only react when newly added DOM nodes contain pricing controls or panels.
Text-content changes made by the pricing runtime must never schedule another repair cycle.
Browser proof must observe ready-v3 and complete lifecycle, plan, billing and NL/EN round-trip interactions.
Do not treat static markup presence as interaction readiness.

evidence.live_symptom: ready-v3 not observable in headless browser despite marker existing in production HTML
